Name: Brands
Description: The brands this record is assigned to.

Name: Amount credited
Description: How much credit has been credited.

Name: Amount remaining
Description: How much credit is remaining.

Name: Comments
Description: Comments to the recipient.

Name: Created by user ID
Description: The user who created this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Object create date/time
Description: The date and time at which this object was created. This value is automatically set by HubSpot and may not be modified.

Name: Credit memo billable
Description: Whether or not the credit memo is billable

Name: Credit memo date
Description: Date the credit memo was issued.

Name: Credit memo reason
Description: Reason for issuing credit
Options: Invoice correction (invoice_correction); Order change/cancellation (order_change_cancellation); Product/service unsatisfactory (product_service_unsatisfactory); Other (other)

Name: Credit memo source
Description: Creation source of the credit memo.

Name: Credit memo status
Description: The status of the credit memo.
Options: Draft (draft); Unapplied (unapplied); Applied (applied); Partially Applied (partially_applied); Voided (voided)

Name: Credit memo tool source
Description: The tool that was used to create the credit memo.

Name: Credit memo url
Description: The credit memo url, based on the domain and slug.

Name: Currency
Description: The currency of the credit memo.

Name: Discounts total
Description: The sum of all line item level discounts and credit memo level discounts applied to the credit memo.

Name: Domain
Description: Domain of the hosted rendered credit memo.

Name: Fees total
Description: The sum of all fees applied to the credit memo.

Name: Language
Description: Language of the credit memo.

Name: Object last modified date/time
Description: Most recent timestamp of any property update for this object. This includes HubSpot internal properties, which can be visible or hidden. This property is updated automatically.

Name: Locale
Description: Locale of the credit memo.

Name: Merged record IDs
Description: The list of record IDs that have been merged into this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Number
Description: The number of the credit memo.

Name: Record ID
Description: The unique ID for this record. This value is set automatically by HubSpot.

Name: Record source detail 1
Description: First level of detail on how this record was created.

Name: Record source detail 2
Description: Second level of detail on how this record was created.

Name: Record source detail 3
Description: Third level of detail on how this record was created.

Name: Record source
Description: How this record was created.

Name: Order level discounts total
Description: The sum of only credit memo level discounts applied to the credit memo.

Name: PDF download url
Description: The url to download the pdf of the credit memo.

Name: PO number
Description: Purchase order number of the credit memo.
